figurative_meaning_en: in one direction; towards one side
example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামের লোকেরা একমুখে নদীর দিকে যাচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: They are all going in the same direction.
The villagers are all heading towards the river in unison.
note: This idiom emphasizes collective movement or alignment, common in Bengali folklore and daily speech.
